description: Test suite for the SQSLogger component, including unit tests for logging, encryption, and health checks within the litellm project.

classes.name: SQSLogger
classes.description: A logger class integrating with Amazon SQS for batched, encrypted logging of events and messages.

classes.name: AppCrypto
classes.description: Encryption utility class supporting JSON data encryption/decryption with optional encryption keys.

methods.name: test_async_sqs_logger_flush()
methods.description: Test that the SQSLogger correctly sends a message after flushing.

methods.name: test_async_sqs_logger_error_flush()
methods.description: Test that errors during flushing are handled and logged appropriately.

methods.name: test_async_log_success_event_adds_to_queue(monkeypatch)
methods.description: Verify success event logging adds to the internal queue.

methods.name: test_async_log_failure_event_adds_to_queue(monkeypatch)
methods.description: Verify failure event logging adds to the internal queue.

methods.name: test_async_send_batch_triggers_tasks(monkeypatch)
methods.description: Test that batch send creates asyncio tasks for asynchronous processing.

methods.name: test_appcrypto_encrypt_decrypt_roundtrip()
methods.description: Verify encryption and decryption produce original data.

methods.name: test_appcrypto_invalid_key_length()
methods.description: Test that invalid key lengths raise appropriate errors.

methods.name: test_sqs_logger_init_without_encryption(monkeypatch)
methods.description: Test SQSLogger instantiation without encryption parameters.

methods.name: test_sqs_logger_init_with_encryption(monkeypatch)
methods.description: Test SQSLogger instantiation with correct encryption setup.

methods.name: test_sqs_logger_init_with_encryption_missing_key(monkeypatch)
methods.description: Ensure missing encryption key raises an error when encryption is enabled.

methods.name: test_strip_base64_removes_file_and_nontext_entries()
methods.description: Confirm base64, file, and audio entries are stripped from messages.

methods.name: test_strip_base64_keeps_non_file_content()
methods.description: Ensure non-file, non-base64 content remains unchanged.

methods.name: test_strip_base64_handles_empty_or_missing_messages()
methods.description: Test behavior when message list is empty or missing.

methods.name: test_strip_base64_mixed_nested_objects()
methods.description: Verify handling of nested objects with mixed content types.

methods.name: test_strip_base64_recursive_redaction()
methods.description: Check that all base64 blobs are properly redacted from nested structures.

methods.name: test_async_health_check_healthy(monkeypatch)
methods.description: Test that health check reports 'healthy' when message sending works.

methods.name: test_async_health_check_unhealthy(monkeypatch)
methods.description: Test that health check reports 'unhealthy' on exceptions during message sending.
